newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Refrigerator plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Refrigerator plans rights issue.

text.p: Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor plans a 2.31-for-10 rights issue at four yuan per share based on shares outstanding after this year's bonus issue, a company statement said on Friday.
The company last month offered three-for-10 bonus shares based on 1996 net profits.
Proceeds from the rights issue will be partly used to create new production capacity of 400,000 air-conditioner compressors and 100,000 to 200,000 air-conditioners per year, the statement said.
The company will also invest some of the proceeds in a project to produce one million refrigerator compressors of a new design per year, it said.
The company will hold a shareholders meeting on August 8 to vote on the plan, the statement said.
Trading in its A and B shares were suspended on Friday morning and will resume this afternoon, it said.
The firm posted a net profit of 109.79 million yuan for 1996 against 86.33 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards, a company 1996 annual report has said.
